ModelsBuilder.//: Nothing, not the InMemoryAuto default: InMemoryAuto needs Umbraco.Cms.DevelopmentMode.Backoffice, whose model factory gets disposed under WebApplicationFactory and then breaks every content operation. Razor runtime compilation is referenced directly instead. No template here needs generated models - they use Model.Name and Value<T>() only.

Imaging.//: NOT a secret. Umbraco writes a random 64-byte key here on install unless one is already present, which would dirty this tracked file on every fresh boot and invite committing a real key by accident. So a fixed, obviously-fake value is committed instead - base64-decode it and it says so. This instance is disposable, serves no media, and is never public; if you ever point it at real media, generate a real key.
